remarks: Welcome to 2650 E. Sycamore Street, Anaheim! Nestled in a desirable, established neighborhood, this charming 4 bedroom and 2.5 bath, single-story home offers a wonderful opportunity to make it your own! Featuring great bones and several important improvements already completed, including dual pane windows, a newer roof, newer central air conditioning heating system with a new furnace, and an entirely new ductwork system. Additional highlights include remodeled three-quarter bathroom and a double-sided fireplace, adding warmth and character to the home. This home provides a great foundation for its next owner.
